content.text: Everyone, please take a look, my right knee is badly swollen.
@Big Liu, your knee does look a bit off. Could you take a side photo?
This is a side view photo. Please take a look and see if there are any issues.
@Big Liu, I think it's an issue with the iliotibial band. This diagram can help you understand the anatomical location.
@Iron Sister, it seems we should use a fascia gun this time. I have a set of pictures of massage heads that I can show you.
@Big Liu, do you feel a sharp pain in your knee? When I injured my knee before, it felt particularly severe.
@Xiao Pi, it does hurt a bit, but not as badly as you said. I think it's better for me to go to the hospital and get it checked.
@DaLiu, remember to tell the doctor that you haven't done enough stretching, as this might be the issue.
@Big Liu, after you come back, I can teach you some yoga stretching exercises to improve your posture.
The doctor said there's no bone injury; here's the X-ray.
@Big Liu It's good that the bones weren't injured. Just follow the doctor's advice.
@Iron Sister, I think Liu should focus more on his stretching exercises to avoid similar situations from happening again.
I've applied the medicated patch, hoping to get better soon.
Everyone, here are the fascia gun and massage heads recommended by Ricky.
@Big Liu These massage heads look good, but you need to be careful when using them and avoid overdoing it.
@Big Liu, remember to use it in conjunction with the iliotibial band anatomy diagram I sent, and apply targeted massage.
@Big Liu, this kit should help alleviate a lot of your pain. Be mindful of the pressure when using it.
Liu, look at the painful expression of this injured player. Make sure you never end up in that situation.
@Xiao Pi, you're just trying to scare me, but I'll be more careful.
@DaLiu, you need to do more proper stretching. I'll send you some demonstrations.
Big Liu, I saw your queue number for the hospital. What did the doctor say?
@Coach Zhang The doctor said there's no bone injury, but advised me to rest and take medication.
@Big Liu, a long-term rehabilitation plan is still necessary; you can't rely solely on medication.
@Iron Sister Agreed, it's still necessary to combine exercise with stretching.
@DaLiu, your stretching posture last time wasn't quite right. I can teach you again.
@Peach Then I'll trouble you with it; I don't want to get hurt again.
This is my X-ray, and the doctor said the bone is fine.
@Big Liu That's good, but you're using the foam roller in the wrong position, so it might not effectively relieve the pain.
@Coach Zhang Indeed, Liu should adjust the position of the foam roller; placing it on the outer side of the thigh would be better.
@Big Liu, you can also try using different massage heads with the percussion massager, which might be more effective.
@Big Liu, don't forget to take it slow and avoid rushing into intense movements.
This is the medicine prescribed by the doctor, and I'm trying it out.
@Big Liu That sounds good, but remember to combine it with stretching for better results.
Check out this foam roller relaxation exercise demonstration, and pay attention to the posture.
@Coach Zhang I will watch it several more times to strive for perfection.
@Big Liu If you feel uncomfortable, adjust your posture promptly.
@Big Liu, remember to persist every day, and you'll see gradual improvement.
@Big Liu, your knee may require a long-term rehabilitation plan; don't take it lightly.
@Big Liu, you might consider incorporating some yoga to help with stretching.
Everyone, take a look at my stretching posture. Does it seem a bit awkward?
@大刘, you're using the foam roller in the wrong position. It should be on the outer side of your thigh, not the front.
@Coach Zhang This will make the iliotibial band issue more severe; adjusting your posture is crucial.
@Everyone, I have a beautiful stretching pose here for comparison, hoping it can help Da Liu.
@Peach, your posture looks very standard. Big Liu could refer to this angle.
@大刘, your stretching looks like you're doing acrobatics, but @桃子的 posture is definitely worth imitating.
@Coach Zhang, I've marked the incorrect angles. Could you take a look and see if this is correct?
@Big Liu Yes, the red lines are marked very well, and the adjustments should lead to significant improvement.
@Everyone, I think Liu can persist in doing these stretches every day to gradually improve the issue.
@Iron Sister Agreed, persistence is key. Stretching on the yoga mat can effectively aid in recovery.
@Daliu, if needed, I can help you adjust your posture. Proper use of the fascia gun is also important.
@Ricky, you also guide stretching postures? I'll definitely come to learn next time!
Thank you for everyone's suggestions. I will adjust my posture and keep practicing, hoping my knee recovers soon.
Everyone, take a look at my patch. Does my knee seem better?
@Big Liu Looks good, how do you feel after applying the medicated patch?
@Big Liu This patch looks quite professional, hopefully it will be effective!
@Big Liu Good start, remember to continue stretching to keep your knees flexible.
@Big Liu I think that plasters can indeed help alleviate pain, but they still need to be combined with exercise.
@Big Liu, remember to use the massage gun, don't forget!
@Iron Sister, the patch feels quite soothing after applying it, but I still don't dare to exert too much force.
@Big Liu Take it slow, don't rush for quick results, and stay patient.
@Big Liu, remember to warm up properly before competitions in the future, otherwise your knees will keep causing trouble.
@Big Liu I can help you develop a long-term rehabilitation plan to gradually recover.
@Big Liu If needed, I can teach you some simple yoga poses to aid in your recovery.
@Big Liu Using the medicated plaster together with the fascia gun yields better results. Don't forget to drink plenty of water.
@Everyone Thank you all for your help, I will persevere!
@Big Liu, keep it up, we're all supporting you!
@Big Liu, I hope you've recovered by the time we meet again!

meta.full_summary:
对话开始。
(第1段摘要): 大刘的膝盖出现严重肿胀，大家怀疑是髂胫束的问题，并建议使用筋膜枪和进行适当拉伸。大刘去医院检查，发现没有骨头损伤，医生开了药膏进行处理。
(第2段摘要): 大刘展示了筋膜枪套装，大家讨论如何使用以帮助他恢复。小皮用球员受伤的动图吓唬大刘。张教头询问了大刘的医院检查结果，大家建议大刘注重拉伸和长远的康复计划。
(第3段摘要): 大刘分享了他的X光片和医生开的药，张教头提供了泡沫轴正确使用的示范。大家建议大刘结合药物和拉伸方法进行康复，并考虑长期的康复计划。
(第4段摘要): 大刘展示了错误的拉伸姿势，大家讨论如何改进。桃子提供了标准拉伸姿势的参考。张教头标注了错误角度，大刘调整后计划坚持练习以改善膝盖问题。
(第5段摘要): 大家对大刘的膝盖伤势进行了最后的指导和鼓励，讨论了膏药的效果，并强调了长期康复的重要性。
resolved_events: 确认大刘膝盖肿胀原因并进行初步处理
大刘的膝盖伤病是否需要长期治疗
大刘的拉伸问题如何进一步改善
大刘膝盖的初步处理已完成，康复计划已制定
